name: desktop-electron
author: marlon-chaviano
title: Desktop app with Electron
description: A cross-platform desktop app with Electron Forge, Vite and TypeScript: secure preload, hot reload and installers for macOS, Windows and Linux.

verify.command: npm run typecheck && npx oxlint && npx oxfmt --check src

instructions:
## How to work here

- Three processes, three files: `src/main.ts` (Node: windows, menus, the file system), `src/preload.ts` (the only bridge) and `src/renderer.ts` (the UI, a web page).
- Security: keep `contextIsolation` on and `nodeIntegration` off. Expose only small, typed functions from the preload with `contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld`, and handle them in main with `ipcMain.handle`. Never expose `ipcRenderer` itself.
- Validate every IPC message in the main process: the renderer is untrusted, like a browser.
- Start with `npm start` (hot reload). Build installers with `npm run make`.
- Format the code with `npx oxfmt src` (`npm run lint` also checks Markdown such as AGENTS.md).
- Before finishing: `npm run typecheck`, `npx oxlint` and `npx oxfmt --check src`.
